Used cross-entropy loss with L2 regularisation and early stopping to curb overfitting and improve generalisation.
Reached 86% test accuracy, outperforming traditional ML baselines.
modelcraft: Built a ReAct-based agent orchestration and tool-calling system that autonomously uses local tools such as search, terminal and Computer Use.

Implemented KV cache and rolling summarisation for context management, improving on-device inference and long-running tasks.
Built an Agentic RAG pipeline with multi-format file parsing and vector retrieval.
amazon: Designed and implemented an efficient RAG workflow with Python, Java and AWS for large-scale document retrieval and intelligent answers.
Built a conversational interface in React Native, optimised for input/output-constrained devices such as Kindle, with smooth, low-latency interaction.
Developed core native modules in C++ for networking and memory management, keeping the app fast and stable on resource-constrained devices.
